scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background
engineering_observations: At step 32 (ascent, root depth 1.6 m), the physically present owned target appears as a nearly vertical dark form, with tail/flukes below and nose above, within all five positive amodal rectangles.

The form is distinct at 0.5 and 1 cm/px, narrows at 2, and becomes a very thin mark at 3 and 4 cm/px. At 4 cm/px the gold rectangle occupies much of its few-pixel-wide presentation; anatomical detail is not resolved at this review scale.
All five negative views show blue water at contact-sheet scale without the corresponding central owned-target form or rectangle. No unrelated animal or overlap is distinguishable in these views.
No material paired background RGB difference is apparent at contact-sheet scale. This observation does not establish bitwise or photometric equality.
Physical presence and rendered_visibility:unknown remain canonical; no frame was excluded or replaced based on these manual engineering observations.
